Couples Therapy Brisbane

Couples Therapy at our hub is focused on breaking cycles of disconnection and rebuilding trust through evidence-based approaches. Sessions teach practical skills in communication, emotional regulation, conflict resolution, and repair strategies so partners can reduce reactivity, restore safety, and create sustainable patterns of closeness. Michelle Barratt Psychology (MBP) provides in-person therapy for couples across Brisbane, and flexible online therapy options Australia-wide, ensuring your healing journey remains consistent and accessible.

How does MBP support Couples Therapy?

Michelle Barratt Psychology and Administrative Services (MBP) provides a neutral, professional administrative hub for couples and clinicians in Brisbane and across Australia . MBP handles the complex logistics of coordinating two schedules, intake communications, and session bookings in an impartial way, so that independent Brisbane psychologists and allied practitioners can preserve their clinical focus and objectivity. This administrative neutrality protects confidentiality, reduces friction, and helps couples access timely, coordinated care.

What support does MBP provide?

Sensitive Intake

Thoughtful intake processes help connect couples with the most suitable practitioner.

Timely scheduling

Prompt appointment coordination helps couples access support sooner.

Flexible Access

Important safety note

If you are in immediate danger, experiencing severe distress, or having thoughts of harming yourself, contact emergency services or a crisis service right away. If you are concerned but not in immediate danger, please mention this when you contact us so we can prioritise an appropriate, timely response.

When Can Couples Therapy Help?

Couples therapy can be beneficial at any stage of a relationship. Many couples seek support when they notice recurring arguments, communication breakdowns, trust issues, emotional disconnection, or difficulties adjusting to major life changes.

Seeking support early can often prevent concerns from becoming more entrenched. Therapy is not about assigning blame—it is about helping both partners better understand each other's perspectives, identify unhelpful patterns, and develop healthier ways of communicating and working together.

Signs Your Relationship May Benefit from Support

Many couples seek therapy when they experience:

  • Frequent conflict or unresolved arguments
  • Difficulties communicating openly and effectively
  • Emotional distance or feeling disconnected
  • Trust concerns or relationship ruptures
  • Parenting or family-related stress
  • Major life transitions or external pressures
  • Reduced intimacy and connection
  • Feeling stuck in repetitive relationship patterns

Couples therapy provides an opportunity to address these challenges in a supportive and structured environment.

Relationship Counselling and Marriage Counselling

Relationship counselling and marriage counselling focus on helping couples strengthen communication, improve understanding, and resolve ongoing challenges. Through guided conversations and practical skill-building, couples can learn healthier ways to navigate conflict, express needs, and reconnect emotionally.

Therapy often focuses on identifying patterns that contribute to relationship distress while helping couples develop strategies that strengthen trust, empathy, and collaboration. Whether a couple is dating, engaged, married, or navigating separation concerns, therapy can provide valuable support and direction.

Enhancing Intimacy and Emotional Closeness

Emotional and physical intimacy play an important role in relationship satisfaction and well-being. Stress, busy lifestyles, communication difficulties, unresolved conflict, and life changes can sometimes impact connection between partners.

Therapy provides a safe and respectful environment to explore concerns related to intimacy, emotional closeness, and relationship satisfaction. By improving communication and understanding, many couples are able to strengthen their connection and develop a more fulfilling relationship.

What is Gottman Therapy?

The Gottman Method is a research-based approach to couples therapy that focuses on strengthening friendship, improving communication, managing conflict, and creating shared meaning within relationships. Developed from decades of relationship research, this approach helps couples understand the habits and behaviours that contribute to healthy, lasting partnerships.

Key areas often explored include:

  • Building friendship and emotional connection
  • Expressing appreciation and respect
  • Managing conflict constructively
  • Improving communication skills
  • Supporting shared goals and values
  • Strengthening trust and commitment

Gottman-based strategies provide practical tools that couples can continue using long after therapy sessions have ended.

Building a Stronger Relationship Together

Healthy relationships require ongoing attention, communication, and effort. While every couple faces challenges, support from an experienced psychologist or relationship therapist can provide the tools and guidance needed to strengthen connection and navigate difficulties more effectively.

Whether your goal is improving communication, rebuilding trust, enhancing intimacy, or simply reconnecting as a couple, professional support can help you move forward with greater confidence, understanding, and resilience.

Every relationship faces challenges from time to time. With the right support, couples can improve communication, strengthen emotional connection, and develop healthier ways of navigating conflict. Seeking help is not a sign of failure—it is often the first step towards creating a stronger, more fulfilling relationship.

Family/Relationship Support section

Relationship challenges can affect more than just the couple involved. Ongoing conflict, communication difficulties, trust concerns, or emotional disconnection can impact family dynamics, parenting, emotional wellbeing, and overall quality of life.

At Michelle Barratt Psychology, we understand that healthy relationships require ongoing care, understanding, and effective communication. Couples therapy provides a supportive environment where partners can strengthen their connection, navigate challenges together, and develop practical skills that support long-term relationship satisfaction.

Whether you are experiencing recurring conflict, adjusting to major life changes, rebuilding trust, or simply wanting to strengthen your relationship, professional support can help you move forward with greater confidence and understanding.
